desc: a co-op guest in the host's world loses the online service (its connection dropped, the relay no longer taking connections) and picks Try again, which can't rejoin: the session is over, but memory still holds the host's world, so a Save Block's save is refused (never the host's adventure over the guest's own file) until a file is loaded or the title (the relay goes away a second after the guest took the host's progress: relay_go, so a slow join under load never meets it first)
